628: impl AsyncRead for File {
629:     fn poll_read(
630:         self: Pin<&mut Self>,
631:         cx: &mut Context<'_>,
632:         dst: &mut ReadBuf<'_>,
633:     ) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
634:         ready!(crate::trace::trace_leaf(cx));
635:         let me = self.get_mut();
636:         let inner = me.inner.get_mut();
637: 
638:         loop {
639:             match inner.state {
640:                 State::Idle(ref mut buf_cell) => {
641:                     let mut buf = buf_cell.take().unwrap();
642: 
643:                     if !buf.is_empty() {
644:                         buf.copy_to(dst);
645:                         *buf_cell = Some(buf);
646:                         return Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
647:                     }
648: 
649:                     let std = me.std.clone();
650: 
651:                     let max_buf_size = cmp::min(dst.remaining(), me.max_buf_size);
652:                     inner.state = State::Busy(spawn_blocking(move || {
653:                         // SAFETY: the `Read` implementation of `std` does not
654:                         // read from the buffer it is borrowing and correctly
655:                         // reports the length of the data written into the buffer.
656:                         let res = unsafe { buf.read_from(&mut &*std, max_buf_size) };
657:                         (Operation::Read(res), buf)
658:                     }));
659:                 }
660:                 State::Busy(ref mut rx) => {
661:                     let (op, mut buf) = ready!(Pin::new(rx).poll(cx))?;
662: 
663:                     match op {
664:                         Operation::Read(Ok(_)) => {
665:                             buf.copy_to(dst);
666:                             inner.state = State::Idle(Some(buf));
667:                             return Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
668:                         }
669:                         Operation::Read(Err(e)) => {
670:                             assert!(buf.is_empty());
671: 
672:                             inner.state = State::Idle(Some(buf));
673:                             return Poll::Ready(Err(e));
674:                         }
675:                         Operation::Write(Ok(())) => {
676:                             assert!(buf.is_empty());
677:                             inner.state = State::Idle(Some(buf));
678:                             continue;
679:                         }
680:                         Operation::Write(Err(e)) => {
681:                             assert!(inner.last_write_err.is_none());
682:                             inner.last_write_err = Some(e.kind());
683:                             inner.state = State::Idle(Some(buf));
684:                         }

686:                             assert!(buf.is_empty());
687:                             inner.state = State::Idle(Some(buf));
688:                             if let Ok(pos) = result {
689:                                 inner.pos = pos;
690:                             }
691:                             continue;

701:     fn start_seek(self: Pin<&mut Self>, mut pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<()> {
702:         let me = self.get_mut();
703:         me.note_seek_request(pos);
704:         let inner = me.inner.get_mut();
705: 
706:         match inner.state {
707:             State::Busy(_) => Err(io::Error::new(
708:                 io::ErrorKind::Other,
709:                 "other file operation is pending, call poll_complete before start_seek",
710:             )),
711:             State::Idle(ref mut buf_cell) => {
712:                 let mut buf = buf_cell.take().unwrap();
713: 
714:                 // Factor in any unread data from the buf
715:                 if !buf.is_empty() {
716:                     let n = buf.discard_read();
717: 
718:                     if let SeekFrom::Current(ref mut offset) = pos {
719:                         *offset += n;
720:                     }
721:                 }
722: 
723:                 let std = me.std.clone();
724: 
725:                 inner.state = State::Busy(spawn_blocking(move || {
726:                     let res = (&*std).seek(pos);
727:                     (Operation::Seek(res), buf)
728:                 }));
729:                 Ok(())

732:     }

740:                 State::Idle(_) => return Poll::Ready(Ok(inner.pos)),

743:                     inner.state = State::Idle(Some(buf));

746:                         Operation::Read(_) => {}
747:                         Operation::Write(Err(e)) => {

749:                             inner.last_write_err = Some(e.kind());

752:                         Operation::Seek(res) => {
753:                             if let Ok(pos) = res {

758:                     }
